note: Design-time statuses (what the integration is, given the credentials the runner has today). Each run writes the live per-provider status into reports/<run>/providers/<name>/status.json; this file is copied into the run as provider_status.snapshot.json.

providers.name: Control measurements (curl timings, TLS, protocol, compression, headers, byte breakdown)
providers.notes: Support measurement used for attribution; also emits the Pingdom-style content-type breakdown as pingdom_breakdown.json (labelled control data).

providers.name: Lighthouse 12 (local, 3-run medians, mobile simulated slow-4G/4x CPU + desktop)
providers.api: npm lighthouse@12.8.2 + chrome-launcher on the runner's Chromium
providers.notes: The performance golden-master guard: scores AND underlying metrics (FCP/LCP/CLS/TBT/SI/TTI, bytes by type, requests, main-thread, long tasks). Individual runs kept in raw.json.

providers.name: WebPageTest (desktop + Moto G4 mobile, 3 runs, first + repeat view)
providers.api: official npm wrapper webpagetest@0.7.6 → www.webpagetest.org REST
providers.notes: Location ids are checked against the live location list before submission.

providers.name: WebPageTest multi-step e-commerce flow (home → product → add to cart → cart → checkout entry)
providers.api: WebPageTest scripting via the same wrapper
providers.notes: Stops before payment by construction. Creates one cart line for a synthetic visitor; never an order.

providers.name: GTmetrix (Lighthouse + Web Vitals, simulated iPhone 14 on a 4G-class connection)
providers.notes: Free tier has a small daily credit; one mobile + one desktop test per audit.

providers.name: DebugBear Quick Tests (LCP sub-parts, CPU breakdown, page weight, request count)
providers.notes: 30 quick tests/day on trial; Mobile + Desktop, eu-west.

providers.name: SpeedVitals multi-region TTFB
providers.notes: Regions come from the live region list; a requested region the API does not offer is reported as not offered.

providers.name: Pingdom
providers.api: free Website Speed Test: none (JS app). Official API 3.1: paid monitoring accounts, read-only checks
providers.notes: The free tool has no API and is not scraped. The per-content-type breakdown it would give is produced by the control measurement instead.

providers.name: Yellow Lab Tools (DOM complexity, JS execution, bad CSS, requests, weight)
providers.notes: Fair use 12 runs / 24 h per IP; one phone run per audit.

providers.name: KeyCDN Performance Test (multi-location TTFB / TLS)
providers.api: none — public JS tool with no official API; the REST API covers CDN zones only
providers.notes: Not scraped. The multi-location question is answered by SpeedVitals and the control measurement.

providers.name: k6 (read-only canary every audit; checkout stress only with --heavy and the dual gate)
providers.credentials: none; heavy needs LOAD_TARGET_URL (+ both production approvals if it is production)
providers.notes: Canary: 2 VUs / 30 s, GET / and /shop. Heavy profile is SKIPPED_FOR_SAFETY until LOAD_TARGET_URL points at a non-production host or both approvals are present; heavy load is also refused from the production application host.

providers.name: Artillery browse → product → cart → checkout-entry journey (no payment)
providers.notes: Heavy-only. Reports SKIPPED_FOR_SAFETY until a safe load target exists.

providers.name: Loader.io (0 → 1000 clients / 60 s)
providers.credentials: LOADERIO_API_KEY + LOADERIO_VERIFICATION_TOKEN; target verification file at the site root
providers.notes: Heavy-only: also gated by LOAD_TARGET_URL and the production approvals. No percentiles in the API (average, success, error and timeout counts only).

providers.name: SpeedCurve synthetic + LUX RUM export
providers.notes: Paid product. Bounce-rate correlation only if the account has LUX; otherwise stated as unavailable.

providers.name: Mozilla HTTP Observatory (security headers, grade, score)
providers.notes: Live on 2026-09-13: grade B+, score 80, 1 failed test.

providers.name: webhint (accessibility, compatibility, performance, security, PWA hints)
providers.api: npm hint@7.1.13 (optional dependency), puppeteer connector on the runner's Chromium
providers.notes: Runs only where the optional dependency installed and a Chromium is available; otherwise PROVIDER_FAILURE with the reason.

providers.name: Compatibility programme (compatibility-audit/: Chromium/Firefox/WebKit journeys, constrained profiles, data usage, PWA, accessibility, visual)
providers.notes: Engine controls are not real Safari / Samsung Internet; evidence class is recorded per cell.
